Label: Medal award
Definition: A medal won by one person in one event of an Olympic Games.
Why no existing term fits: No ontology checked has a class for one medal won in one event: dbo:Award is the prize itself; dbo:goldMedalist links an event straight to a person and cannot carry the team

Label: awarded to
Definition: The person who won the medal.
Why no existing term fits: No property links an award to its winner; dbo:medalist goes from the event to the person

Label: in event
Definition: The event in which the medal was won.
Why no existing term fits: No property links an award to its event; dcterms:relation is too vague

Label: won by
Definition: The team (one nation in one discipline) that the medal counts for.
Why no existing term fits: No property links an award to a team

Label: medal type
Definition: Gold, silver or bronze, as an entry of the Medal type code list.
Why no existing term fits: No medal-type property in any vocabulary checked

Label: event category
Definition: Who may compete in the event: men, women, mixed or open.
Why no existing term fits: BBC sport:eventGender has no 'open', expects BBC's own class and is unmaintained

Label: officiates in
Definition: The discipline in which a technical official (judge, referee, umpire…) works.
Why no existing term fits: dbo:sportDiscipline is the discipline a person practises, not one they officiate; BBC sport:discipline expects BBC's own class

Label: officiates as
Definition: The function of a technical official (judge, referee, umpire…), as an entry of the Function code list.
Why no existing term fits: org:role needs an org:Membership in an organisation, and the source gives officials none; dbo:occupation is a profession

Label: coaches athlete
Definition: A coach of a team or squad to which the athlete belongs. Derived by query from org:Membership and org:memberOf; never stated in the source.
Why no existing term fits: No vocabulary links a coach to individual athletes; the source only links coaches to a team
